vb_textbox.text: Scoring ranges from 0-9. Pink/purple appear to be linked and brown/green are linked, e.g. if purple is scoring high, stick with the pink or purple hats. When the numbers drop, switch to brown\green. Sometimes the numbers seem to be low for both sides, you might have to switch around a bit to find the best one. The numbers seem to rise and fall through the experiment, play around and you'll find the combination that's scoring highest. Good Luck!
